problem: Brokerage teams spend most of the day on manual work such as quoting, load building, carrier sourcing, appointment scheduling, tracking and paperwork, on thin margins.
business_model: B2B AI agents sold per deployment; pricing not published
product_category: AI teammates for freight brokerage operations

founders.name: Bobby Zhong
founders.background_notes: YC page says he grew up in a logistics family. A profile says he dropped out; the YC page does not.

competitors.name: Vooma
competitors.what: AI agents for brokers and carriers handling email, text and voice tasks like quoting, load building and tracking
competitors.traction_then: Customers reported to include Echo, MODE, Arrive Logistics and NFI

competitors.name: Augment
competitors.funding_then: $85M Series A led by Redpoint, announced 2025-09, $110M total

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs integrations with TMS systems, inboxes, phone lines and portals, voice agents and LLM workflows with human escalation. Hard integration work but no research risk; the founders built coding agents and data pipelines at Replo.

defensibility.rationale: Per customer training and deep TMS integration create some lock-in, but several funded rivals sell the same wedge and agents are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded rivals raised large rounds in 2024 and 2025 for the same wedge. No acquisition of Burt found.

market_need_then: Freight brokerage is relationship driven with thin margins and heavy manual email and phone work, and funded startups were raising for the same problem in 2024 and 2025.

branding.domain_note: burthq.com for the site; YC listings show a trainburt.com email domain

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and operational; positions the product as a coworker, tagline 'AI Teammates Built For Logistics'

branding.brand_signature: A human first name for the AI teammate
branding.community_and_virality: No community, merch or press about the brand found

brand_strength.rationale: A friendly human name fits the teammate positioning, but no press or community evidence was found and the name is common.

pivots.from: Training specialized models that beat frontier models on cost and latency
pivots.to: AI teammates for freight brokers and forwarders
pivots.why: Profile says the company began with specialized models and then focused them on freight; the year is not stated in sources, so the date is approximate

outcome_analysis: Early and active with no public outcome. The CEO grew up in a logistics family and both founders built agent and data systems at a YC company. The market is crowded with funded competitors such as Vooma and Augment, so execution and integration depth will decide the result. Funding is not public.
notes: One aggregator profile mentions roughly $130,000 seed through YC, seen on a single secondary site and unverified, so no round is recorded. The metrics on the site (2,500 loads in a week) are marketing claims. The pivot date is approximate. Founding year differs across sources (2025 or 2026). No outcome news found. Completeness pass: Round rests on a single outlet (YesPress, about 130K seed in January 2026); PitchBook conflicts with a 500K Y Combinator deal dated January 2026, not recorded.
